# 2. The compliance-exclusion rule

`compliance_content_excluded = True`

No character line may state a legal, licensing, PPE, storage, SDS, spraying, notification or reporting obligation. Those belong to T04-CT-04, quoted from the source.

This is not stylistic caution. The source states that pesticide spraying must be done by a licensed operator — a competence the character bank does not give Encik Rahman. A mentor character stating a statutory duty converts a source citation into a character's word. A gate holds this rule.

# 3. Dialogue beats

The lines below are therefore CAIR_ASSISTED_DRAFT on the same footing as the Rumusan — proposed, not approved, and hers to rewrite.*

### Beat 1 — Alya

**Intent.** Ask what follows once the construction and planting work is finished.

**Source rows.** T04-ROW-002

> Encik Rahman, kerja pembinaan dan tanaman di tapak ini dah siap. Selepas ini apa yang perlu diuruskan?

### Beat 2 — Encik Rahman

**Intent.** Name the maintenance phase and point at its process flow.

**Source rows.** T04-ROW-001, T04-ROW-002, T04-ROW-003

> Sekarang masuk fasa penjagaan dan penyelenggaraan. Ada enam aktiviti penyeliaan yang perlu berjalan, daripada koordinasi kerja sampailah kepada perancangan sumber manusia.

### Beat 3 — Alya

**Intent.** Ask whether maintenance is the same for everything on site.

**Source rows.** T04-ROW-005, T04-ROW-080

> Semua elemen di tapak diselenggara sama caranya?

### Beat 4 — Encik Rahman

**Intent.** Draw the soft/hard distinction that organises the unit.

**Source rows.** T04-ROW-004, T04-ROW-005, T04-ROW-079, T04-ROW-080

> Tidak. Landskap lembut itu elemen hidup — pokok, rumput, tanaman. Landskap kejur pula elemen binaan yang kekal. Keperluan penyelenggaraannya berbeza.

### Beat 5 — Alya

**Intent.** Close on the learner's own next step.

**Source rows.** T04-ROW-002

> Jadi saya kena faham keperluan kedua-duanya sebelum susun jadual penyelenggaraan.
